title: A free version of ChatGPT built for teachers
summary: ChatGPT for Teachers is a secure workspace with education‑grade privacy and admin controls. Free for verified U.S. K–12 educators through June 2027.
body: ChatGPT for Teachers is a secure workspace with education‑grade privacy and admin controls. Free for verified U.S. K–12 educators through June 2027.
summaryZh: OpenAI为美国K-12教育工作者推出了ChatGPT教育版，强调隐私保护和管理控制。该产品主要面向教育行业，不涉及底层模型架构的更新。
